claim_audit_results.claim_summary: The scope requires demonstration cases to take socio-economic pressures into account (SR-03), carried by P11.
The compliance profile requires FAIR data and links to the open science cloud and common data spaces, carried by P10 and P04.
A gender equality plan and an ethics review are required for this call.
No partner records dedicated expertise in the gender dimension of research content (a flagged gap).
Each activity rests on infrastructure a partner already operates (field, laboratory, observation, data facilities, uptake network).
claim_audit_results.flag_reason: Infrastructure access rests on Assumed, unconfirmed participation.

claim_audit_results.claim_summary: Three SMEs (P04, P05, P12) own the project's routes to use.
claim_audit_results.flag_reason: Exploitation roles are design intent over unconfirmed participation.

claim_audit_results.claim_summary: Member States and Associated Countries are both funding limbs under the General Annexes.
The essentiality clause applies only to an entity established outside the listed funding limbs.
The destination Biodiversity and ecosystem services exempts an RIA from the China participation restriction.
The consortium holds no affiliated entities, so none is counted towards the composition minimum.
The composition condition is met only under assumption; the derived six (P01-P06) span two Member State slots, one short of the Tier 1 minimum.
